why_benign: assetUrl uses Math.random only as a cache-buster appended to a non-security asset URL — it feeds no credential, identifier-of-record, or access decision. Flagging it as insecure randomness is a false positive (the SELECTIVITY clause says to leave it alone). It sits 6 lines from the security-relevant magic-link PRNG (line 11), so the two are cleanly separable under RANGE_TOL=5.
